_meta.name: M4 live public-data capability screen (AlphaSense-sourced)
_meta.purpose: Real, cited target-screening data that demonstrates what Module 4 actually does: pull public-company data and score it on the Target Attractiveness Score. This is a capability demonstration on listed comparables, NOT a solicitation and NOT investment advice. The anonymized Anchor x Polaris thread in spine.json remains the illustrative private-deal case that flows into M5.
_meta.source: AlphaSense market scan (GenSearch, web-augmented) + AlphaSense broker/earnings citations
_meta.disclaimer: Public-data screen for capability demonstration only. Figures are approximate, drawn from public filings and market data as cited; not a recommendation, valuation, or approach to any company. Real mid-market acquisition targets are typically private and confidential - see the illustrative thread below.
_meta.acquirerContext: Anchor Tech Services Ltd - listed BFSI technology-services firm, ~Rs 4,800 Cr revenue, seeking specialty data-engineering capability.
_meta.thesis: Specialty data-engineering / BFSI-facing, founder- or promoter-led, listed, revenue roughly Rs 250-2,500 Cr, absorbable into a Rs 4,800 Cr acquirer.
_meta.scaleNote: Each TAS dimension scored 0-100 from the cited signals; TAS = weighted sum (Transactability 30, Strategic fit 35, Integration risk inverse 25, Data confidence 10). Scarcity is a tie-breaker, not a scored factor.

candidates.name: Nucleus Software Exports
candidates.fit: Pure-play BFSI lending platforms and data - closest to the named gap; clean bolt-on at ~18% of acquirer revenue.
candidates.signal: Cheap at ~16x P/E, net cash ~Rs 416 Cr, but margins compressed 32.5%->15.6% YoY on AI-first reinvestment; first non-promoter professional Chair appointed Mar 2026 (governance professionalisation).
candidates.dataConfidenceNote: Listed - financials, ownership and board changes AlphaSense-supplied; succession intent needs manual enrichment.

sources.note: P/E ~16x, net cash ~Rs 416 Cr, margin compression

candidates.name: Aurionpro Solutions
candidates.fit: High BFSI focus - transaction banking, fintech, data-centre buildout; strong capability adjacency.
candidates.signal: Low promoter stake (26.9%, flagged as a watchpoint) with FII interest at ~16.3%; net cash ~Rs 331 Cr, growing ~20% YoY but a weak Q4FY26 and near 52-week low.
candidates.dataConfidenceNote: Listed - AlphaSense-supplied incl. DAM Capital broker note; control dynamics at low promoter stake need judgement.

sources.note: Aurionpro Q4FY26 (Buy) - weak quarter; large datacentre deal to aid FY27

candidates.name: Happiest Minds Technologies
candidates.fit: Digital / product engineering + GenAI, some BFSI - capability adjacent but not specialty-data pure-play; near the top of the size band.
candidates.signal: Strongest exit signal in the pool: founder sold 6% (~Rs 763 Cr block) for philanthropy and succession, promoter now ~44%; but stock -40% in a year and now leveraged (D/E ~0.86, debt ~Rs 1,350 Cr).
candidates.dataConfidenceNote: Listed - stake sale and leverage AlphaSense-supplied; large size + new leverage raise integration risk.

candidates.name: Latent View Analytics
candidates.fit: Data analytics and AI-first services - excellent capability match to specialty data engineering; crossed Rs 1,000 Cr revenue in FY26.
candidates.signal: Low transactability: founders re-appointed for five-year terms in 2026 and hold a stable 65.1%; expensive at ~31x P/E; very strong balance sheet (net cash ~Rs 728 Cr, ~zero debt).
candidates.dataConfidenceNote: Listed - AlphaSense-supplied; founder commitment signals make a sale unlikely near term.

sources.note: Founders re-appointed 5-yr terms; P/E ~31x; net cash ~Rs 728 Cr

candidates.name: Saksoft Ltd
candidates.fit: Data and digital engineering with moderate BFSI exposure; debt-free and cleanly absorbable.
candidates.signal: Low transactability: promoter is an active open-market buyer (~80k shares Feb-Apr 2026), zero pledge, stake up to 66.7% - a commitment signal, not an exit; attractive at ~16-18x P/E, growing ~18%.
candidates.dataConfidenceNote: Listed - AlphaSense-supplied; promoter buying reduces near-term availability.

candidates.name: Ksolves India
candidates.fit: Data-engineering delivery (big-data, Odoo, Salesforce), emerging BFSI - lowest integration risk as a small, debt-free tuck-in (~3% of acquirer revenue).
candidates.signal: Founders active, exceptional capital efficiency (ROE ~137%), net debt-free; management explicitly stated in early 2026 there are no plans to sell or buy back at current levels.
candidates.dataConfidenceNote: Listed micro-cap - AlphaSense-supplied incl. Q4FY26 investor deck; thin BFSI depth needs enrichment.

candidates.name: Intellect Design Arena
candidates.fit: Pure-play BFSI product platforms - strong domain, but a platform/product company above the size band (~63% of acquirer revenue) - a merger, not a bolt-on.
candidates.signal: Promoter stake ~29.7% with no distress or stated review; growth intact. Above the target size band on both revenue and scale.
candidates.dataConfidenceNote: Listed - AlphaSense-supplied; flagged out-of-band on size.

exclusions.name: Expleo Solutions
exclusions.reason: MNC-owned (Expleo Group, France) - no independent promoter to transact with.

exclusions.name: KFin Technologies
exclusions.reason: PE-backed (General Atlantic) - a financial-sponsor exit, not a founder sale; different price and process.

exclusions.name: Cigniti Technologies
exclusions.reason: Already acquired by Coforge - no longer independent.

exclusions.name: 63 Moons Technologies
exclusions.reason: Pure-play fintech with a heavy legacy litigation/regulatory overhang - reputational and integration risk outweigh fit.

illustrativeThread.note: The end-to-end walkthrough (M1 gap -> M4 selection -> M5 seven-gate deal) follows an anonymized private target, Polaris Data Group. Real mid-market targets are typically private and confidential; a public-data screen like the one above surfaces listed comparables and market signals, while the actual acquisition thread is illustrated on an anonymized case.
